summary: PLAT-103: validateApp now throws if owner missing/empty (shared-contracts bumped to 2.0.0, major). Core-shell (platform), billing (payments) and reports (insights) pass owner from their package.json team. Assumptions: shared-contracts lives in the monorepo and is inlined at build time, so no registry release or dependency bump applies; all three subtasks shipped in one PR (#1) since there's no ordering problem. Reports also calls validateApp, so I updated it to avoid a latent break (it isn't deployed by CD). Owner values are literals matching package.json.
